decisions.decision: Proceed with the selected quality-budget formal queue after stronger attack candidates were scoped.
decisions.rationale: The user requested autonomous continuation toward a reliable paper framework.

decisions.decision: Use stego-vs-attacked PSNR >= 30 dB and LPIPS <= 0.10 as the fairness budget.
decisions.rationale: This separates image quality from payload destruction and makes attack parameters comparable.

decisions.decision: Treat Regen-VAE and UnMarker as adapted attack baselines, not full paper reproductions.
decisions.rationale: The workspace uses their attack primitives inside native reveal protocols rather than reproducing their complete original evaluation harnesses.

decisions.decision: Exclude calibration sample indices 0-9 from formal paper estimates.
decisions.rationale: Those samples selected attack parameters, so retaining them in formal tables would leak selection into evaluation.

decisions.decision: Only score native recovery failures as zero when a saved measurable attacked image pair exists.
decisions.rationale: Runner failures before an attacked artifact exists do not demonstrate attack effectiveness.

next_action: Keep the selected queue running. When it completes, require final LPIPS coverage and fixed-budget audit on held-out rows before using paper claims; inspect and repair any unscorable failures rather than treating them as attack success.
